title: SQL analytics endpoint metadata sync option (preview)

content.text: You can now opt in to the new SQL analytics endpoint metadata sync option, a preview feature. The new option, which is currently opt-in only and currently applies only to new SQL analytics endpoints, is faster, provides a new manual metadata sync option, and provides time travel querying.
